display_title: HORIZON-CL6-2027-02-FARM2FORK-02-two-stage Optimising the water-nutrient-energy nexus for sustainable and climate smart agriculture in Africa (FNSSA) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL6-2027-02-FARM2FORK-02-two-stage Optimising the water-nutrient-energy nexus for sustainable and climate smart agriculture in Africa (FNSSA)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Cluster 6 Research and Innovation Action, forthcoming, that funds research on integrated water, nutrient and energy management for smallholder farms in at least two African agro-ecosystems, using a multi-actor approach with public authorities, advisory services and farmer organisations. Consortia must include at least three independent legal entities established in African Union member states, which are exceptionally eligible for funding. The topic has EUR 12 million for an expected two projects of about EUR 6 million each, paid as a lump sum; up to 30% of the budget may go to financial support to third parties, at most EUR 60,000 each. It opens on 4 February 2027 and is two-stage: first stage 8 April 2027, second stage 14 September 2027.
status_rationale: The topic funds research on on-farm management of water, nutrient and energy inputs for smallholder agriculture in African agro-ecosystems, with a multi-actor approach and at least three partners from African Union member states (topic page, Expected Outcome, Scope and Other Eligible Conditions). No project file is close: its energy element concerns energy use on African farms, not transmission, grid operation, flexibility or offshore energy, so the call does not touch TenneT's field.
